long_ride_edges_ge_18pct.manual_resolution: required_first_visit: 12721 is accepted only after the Zol'Maz tasks are turned in at Zim'Torga; Gundrak flight point is still unopened, so the first northbound leg must be ground travel.
direct_ground_is_shorter: both Zim'Torga and Gundrak are open, but route-model comparison gives about 1.57 min direct versus 2.27 min via Zim'Torga taxi Gundrak; keep direct ride.

long_ride_edges_ge_18pct.to: 希姆托加·佐尔玛兹回收
long_ride_edges_ge_18pct.manual_resolution: required_hub_unlock: 12707/12708/12709/12712 must be turned in at Zim'Torga to unlock 12721; cannot continue north before this hub return.
direct_ground_is_shorter: Voltarus is already closed locally with Stefan's Horn; direct Pain→Argent is about 1.09 min versus about 2.46 min by backtracking to Ebon then taking taxi.
strict_chain: 12675 turns in at Harkoa and directly unlocks 12684 at Mamtoth; no useful intermediate unlock exists on this edge.
strict_chain_return: 12684 must return to Harkoa to unlock 12685; this is the mandatory reverse leg of the same deity chain.
required_turnin: 12516 and 12596 both close at Argent Stand; no flight point exists at Sseratus and no newly unlocked cluster can replace the hub return.
whole-loop_order_checked: the current Sprayer→Zim'Abwa→Argent→Basilisk ordering is about 213 yards shorter than Argent→Zim'Abwa→Basilisk using the same anchors.
same_quest_two_sources: both are required essence sources for 12729; the long edge connects the two mandatory objectives before the single Harkoa turn-in.
strict_chain: turning 12666 at Harkoa unlocks 12667, whose next required endpoint is Quetz'lun; no intermediary task is available to break the edge.

intentional_cluster_bridge: these are the two material sources for 12914; diatomaceous earth is at the Ebon entrance, so this edge intentionally converts the Gymer material quest into the bridge to the Ebon chain.
